title: Tofu Tower
tagline: Stack the cosiest tofu in town.
description: Stack soft, dewy blocks of fresh tofu into a wobbling tower at a quiet Japanese teahouse. Tofu Tower is a free idle clicker browser game blending Japanese cosy aesthetics with classic incremental progression. Tap the worktop to drop a fresh block, watch your tower grow taller through gentle morning light, and earn coins while you sleep. Hire apprentice tofu makers to keep the tower rising on its own, brew warm soy milk to boost yields, light paper lanterns for lucky draws, and call on yokai helpers for permanent multipliers. When your tower reaches the heavens, prestige into a new teahouse and earn inkan stamps that boost every future run. Plays portrait on mobile, no install required.

controls.en: Tap the bath to drop capybaras and earn coins. Open the shop to upgrade.
controls.ja: 湯舟をタップしてカピバラを呼ぶ。ショップで強化。
